crossRefs.note: David came to Saul, and stood before him. He loved him greatly; and he became his armor bearer.
Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul took him that day, and wouldn’t let him go home to his father’s house any more.
translations.bsb: And from that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return to his father’s house.
translations.kjv: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.
translations.asv: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.
